title: ICC-ES ESR-4692: PorterCorp structural insulated panels (SIPs)
jurisdiction: United States (ICC-ES evaluation report under IBC/IRC); NON-ALBERTA COMPARATIVE ONLY: cannot establish Alberta performance, acceptance or equivalence; no Canadian or Alberta approval is claimed or implied
document_date: Reissued April 2026; subject to renewal April 2027 (p1)

facts.text: Report holder PORTERCORP; subject is structural insulated panels.
SIPs are roof, floor and wall panels, combustible for construction type under IBC Chapter 6, and may be used as fire-resistance-rated assemblies per §4.3.1-4.3.3.
SIPs must be fabricated, identified and erected per the report, the manufacturer's installation instructions and the approved construction documents; the more restrictive requirement governs.

Design loads must be determined per the IBC or IRC and must not exceed the allowable loads in the report; where SIP shear walls of different widths are combined in one wall line, or with other shear elements, in SDC D, E or F under the IBC, lateral loads are proportioned by relative stiffness.
Calculations and details showing lateral-load transfer must be signed and sealed by a registered design professional where the jurisdiction's statutes require.
Identification clause §7.1.1 cites 'the ICC-ES Evaluation Report number (ESR-4689)', although this report is ESR-4692; the discrepancy needs confirmation with the holder.
Evidence listed: AC04 (June 2019, editorially revised December 2020); ASTM E455 diaphragm tests; cyclic shear per AC04 Appendix A; ASTM E119; NFPA 286.
